# Performance History

The original Blitz3D is the baseline at the top, then one row per version tag of BlitzLLVM, built and benchmarked on its own with the short benchmark set (`benchmarks/history_commits.py --tags`, 3 runs, mean ± standard deviation). What changed in a version is in its release notes. 📈 is better, 📉 is worse and ➖ is the same as the baseline (a change under 3%, or one under two standard deviations of the difference, counts as the same). Last updated 2026-11-01.

## Machine

| | |
| --- | --- |
| CPU | AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D, 16 threads |
| GPU | NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER |
| OS and version | Windows 11 Pro 24H2 (10.0.26100) |
| RAM | 64 GB DDR5-6400 |
| VRAM | 16 GB |
| Renderer / converter | Vulkan, NVIDIA driver (native) |

Numbers of different machine definitions can not be compared. Every program runs windowed, one after the other, with nothing else running.
